## Result and intended use

The generic solvent-specification driver reproduces **all 213 admitted reactive
objective rows exactly**, at dimensionless subset cost **45.37796168239049**.
The largest relative difference is zero for every prediction, residual,
weighted residual and row cost. All rows are `Available` and meet their native
requested numerical tolerance. There is no first differing target.

This is numerical verification of declaration mapping at the supplied endpoint,
not independent physical validation. No fit, parameter adoption, manuscript
change, phase search or absorber qualification was performed. The published
[issue #233](https://github.com/tannerpolley/Amine-Thermodynamics/issues/233)
owns the scope and comparison tolerance, $10^{-10}$ relative per field.

| Group | Rows | Actual cost | Reference cost | Relative difference |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| common149 | 149 | 23.860996312136727 | 23.860996312136727 | 0 |
| restored species | 7 | 2.4486746519412517 | 2.4486746519412517 | 0 |
| Jakobsen | 6 | 13.122182452954206 | 13.122182452954206 | 0 |
| loaded density | 47 | 0.5654031419421082 | 0.5654031419421082 | 0 |
| Cp | 4 | 5.380705123416196 | 5.380705123416196 | 0 |
| Subset | 213 | 45.37796168239049 | 45.37796168239049 | 0 |

Stable summation uses the retained objective $C=\frac12\sum_j w_jr_j^2$.
Pressure remains in Pa; species mole fractions and amount ratios retain their
source denominators; heat remains signed J/mol added CO₂; density is kg/m³;
heat capacity is J/(mol analytical feed K). Source scales and final weights are
unchanged. The comparison checks numerical identity, not experimental error.

## Inputs and construction checks

The accounting base is `62e256d940731d7f256d24f0bbe9034690458ca9`.
The supplied parameter document remains byte-identical to the accepted endpoint,
SHA-256 `00e77608a8489fc9e03a7d2a86c08cb5ff782bb441368a62fa6390b8bfe9cc91`.
The paper wheel is merged Engine `3e83e19ccc771b51d8ebc038931ab25192f4c5b5`,
SHA-256 `0d08dff9be39fb8fc9018119c47612f53d823cd0e456914d7dd44c6941596804`.
Every installed Engine package file was compared with its wheel bytes.
Python is 3.13.14, NumPy 2.5.4 and SciPy 1.18.1.

Preparation compared all native observation and problem fields recursively with
the historical construction owners before evaluation. This includes the 13
request-backed amended declarations, their stored seeded feeds and guesses,
phase names, reaction references and existing 293.15–436.85 K construction
bounds. Evaluation uses the unamended endpoint. Element and charge balance,
species charge agreement and caloric coverage passed the generic driver checks.
Carbamate retains one analytical amine and one carbon unit. Empty coordinates
and phase-state lists are explicitly endpoint-only inputs.

The runtime imports none of `fit_observations`, `fit_campaign` or
`shared_evaluation`. It consumes only prepared TOML/CSV/JSON, installed Engine,
and the generic driver. Source transformations and chemistry preparation remain
with their existing owners; no new source interpretation was made here.

## MDEA and caloric checks

MDEA was checked in its separate d5138209 environment, wheel SHA-256
`ca7093ca721fdc80226c74d018a582f31705684c6995e80b0492c193334dd5d5`,
with installed package bytes verified. Existing R1/R3/R5 checks passed in
12.93 s using 32 worker processes and one numerical-library thread per process.

| Check | Actual | Reference | Assessment |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| R1 B1 cost | 374.4520134237422 | 374.45201342397434 | relative difference 6.1995e-13; maximum weighted-residual absolute difference 4.5461e-11 |
| R3 Ermatchkov mean absolute relative deviation, % | 19.1460124028601 | 19.1460124028601 | 88 rows, exact agreement |
| R5 A3 cost | 403.7149851474161 | 403.71498514705206 | within 1e-8 relative; coordinates identical |

The caloric mapping invariant supplied nonzero anchors of 1234.5 J/mol and
6.75 J/(mol K) at 313.15 K. Mapped and directly constructed Engine records
agreed within 1e-13 relative at 313.15 and 333.15 K. Ideal enthalpies were
1234.5 and 3023.5337971466283 J/mol; ideal entropies at 1 mol/m³ were
37.08321058816546 and 42.10522260544719 J/(mol K). The entropy includes the
Engine ideal-density contribution; it is not the standard-pressure anchor.
The pure neutral MEA record isolates this check from ionic reference completion.
The persistent check took 0.12 s.

## Evidence, timing and limits

[Row predictions](results/predictions.json), [every row difference and group
reduction](results/endpoint-checks.json), [input hashes and runtime](results/runtime.json),
[preparation provenance](inputs/preparation-provenance.json),
[MDEA environment](results/mdea-runtime.json), and
[caloric values](results/caloric-anchor.json) retain the numerical evidence.
The fresh MEA pass used one process and one numerical-library thread at niceness
10. Its measured wall time is in `results/runtime.json`; the initial successful
pass took 7.1552 s; the final pass took 7.2805 s. No parallel campaign was needed.

The source-derived uncertainty, calibration roles, active-bound restrictions
and source-range extrapolation labels remain those of the accepted endpoint.
R2/R4/R5 candidate-law support remains 293.15–393.15 K; the 13 broader
construction declarations do not establish validity above 393.15 K. Kiepe,
Cai and CO₂-free density are deferred. This subset does not reproduce the full
307-row manuscript objective or qualify neutral continuation, free temperature,
fitting, phase stability, kinetics or column transport.

Independent delivered review and investigator acceptance remain outstanding.
No result here is promoted for manuscript or absorber use.
